posts.title: The Best Day of My Life
posts.summary: A father flew his kids at first light to the Oklahoma-Texas game (Cotton Bowl, 2023); at the end of a long day his son said it was the best day of his life without knowing he was heard. The first commissioned canvas; opens the journal.
